name: How do you typically repair a leaking shower pan?

mainEntity.name: How do you typically repair a leaking shower pan?

acceptedAnswer.text: Repairing a leaking shower pan often involves removing existing tiles to access and replace the damaged pan liner or pre-sloped mortar bed. Depending on the extent of damage, it may require installing a new waterproof membrane and rebuilding the shower floor. Proper slope and sealing are crucial to prevent future leaks. Sometimes, a full shower replacement is necessary if the pan's base structure is compromised.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repairing a leaking shower pan usually requires removing tiles to replace the damaged liner or mortar bed, ensuring proper waterproofing and slope.
